name: JINKI RESURRECTION
original_name: ジンキ・リザレクション
source:
Set 2 years after the end of the Complete Edition of the original manga.

Ryouhei woke up in a hospital, having lost all his memories, even his own name. In search of clues on how to regain them, he arrived in Kyoto and was welcomed by a group of girls who were part of an organization called Angel. He would end up living together with the three girls: the friendly Aoba, the reserved Akao, and the openly-hostile Kanae. He thought that it wouldn’t be that bad living like this with them, but it would soon all be turned upside down by the existence of large humanoid robots called “Jinki”.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
故事设定在原作漫画完全版完结两年后。

良平在医院醒来，失去了所有记忆，甚至连自己的名字都没有。为了寻找如何重新获得它们的线索，他到达了京都，并受到了一群女孩的欢迎，她们是一个名为“天使”的组织的成员。他最终与三个女孩住在一起：友好的青叶、内向的赤尾和公开敌对的鼎。他本以为这样和他们一起生活也不会太糟糕，但很快这一切就会因为一个名为“Jinki”的大型人形机器人的存在而发生翻天覆地的变化。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
